notes.title: Full Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/dc2c44509a247ef0ff00c19e43f19aadacd7493c.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]

Hello everyone!
[h3]"World End Diner" has finally reached full release![/h3]


It has been over three years since we launched the game in Early Access in 2021.

To date, I have updated the game more than 500 times, including minor updates, and have continued to add various elements and content.

What was only available up to lvl 10 at the start of Early Access is now filled with a wealth of content.


Restaurant elements, apocalypse content, inn management and souvenir shelves, part-time jobs, hot springs and bonfires, a diner code system, various quests, unique events, and more. ....
I have added countless elements that have allowed us to grow into a very large game.

I also created two years of seasonal events that are now available to newcomers to the game as well as those who enjoy them season after season.

I have been able to make so many updates thanks to so many of you who have played this game!

[hr][/hr]

Now,
 as we approach the full release,
[h3] I have made a small update.[/h3]


If you have reached the maximum level, level 30, please talk to the librarian robot and unlock [b]the last crypto library[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/b6f8f1487650ff7352f81de14644630d8d709255.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/b18d5fe7aa7afde6c1dfb189c0acfa4ac27f1ea8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/0ab9f08101db819b6319269ee2b922c99e407cd7.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

Thanks to all of you who have written reviews, distributed game copies, and written articles.
And to everyone who loved this game, thank you!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/691ed2c81fd6d65bf9427dd9d2e249b1aa30d7a7.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!
I am pleased to announce that I have updated World End Diner!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Lv30 is now unlocked![/h3]
[list]
For all of you awesome diner keepers who have already reached Lv 29 at this point, Lv 30 has finally been implemented in the game.
At Lv30, the long-sealed [b]Apocalypse recipes[/b] of the Librarian Robot will finally be released!

These recipes are not only the phantom recipes that have been lost in the long time after the two robot wars, but also the recipes of different cuisines that were born in the collapse of the earth and the destruction of mankind.

Once you reach lvl 30, talk to the Librarian Robot.
On the third tab of the Librarian Robot menu, you will find it.
There you will find 9 different apocalypse recipes of various backgrounds and waiting for you!

Learning those recipes can be very difficult, but as specially positioned recipes, the unit price per dish for each of them is also set very high.
[/list]

[h3]New Furniture[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Monolith" (Lv 30)
[*] "Holy Axe" (Lv 30)
[*] "Holy Sickle (Lv 30)
[*] "Holy Fishing Rod" (Lv30)
[/list]

[h3]Other Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cloud saving is now supported.
[*] Added the number of "Bucket," "Battery (empty)," and "Seawater Tank" sales.
[*] Added a few more pieces of furniture that can be obtained from treasure chests on the map.
[*] The animals will now give you a third tent if you play a lot of hours.
[*] Added a quest for the "Pizza Oven" recipe.
[*] Added a Lv 30 STEAM Achievement.
[*] Added a robot that will give you a little hint at lvl 2. It will probably appear in diners who are already at a high Lv, but please give him a warm welcome when he does.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/65eba6486c5da7ec969c6f24ca3109e061d4101b.jpg[/img]

[*] Frogs have been implemented. You may encounter them in the morning on summer days or on rainy days if you are lucky.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/90f6c52aed546d9a1c1dd4d91da133791675ae04.jpg[/img]

[*] In the capacity skill tree in the Clover skill, the following skills have been added to the effect of increasing the amount of increase when acquiring AP.
* The skill "Maximum AP +6000" has been added to "AP +1".
* The skill "AP +2" has been added to the skill "AP Max +8000.
* The skill "Max AP +17,000" has been added with "AP +3".
[*] In the capacity skill tree in the clover skill, the value of skill increase rate after lvl. 4 for the skills that increase the maximum lvl. of the elements of nature, dexterity, water, and fire have been increased respectively. (The previous increments of +1,+1,+2 have been changed to +1,+2,+3.)
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
That's all for this update..

Now, 
During this period, I'd like to thank everyone who filed bug reports and everyone who streamed videos on Youtube, Twitch, Nico Nico Video, etc.!


Also, a big thank you to those of you who wrote STEAM reviews!
Your wonderful reviews have been a great encouragement to me in developing the game!

If any of you haven't written a review yet, please do, it would make me very happy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/a7dd32876b090048c1a29251524b57da70f92e78.png[/img]
Please enjoy "World End Diner"!
Thank you.

When this "part-time board" is installed, a part-time job skill growth system will be added.

In this mode, the " friendship" with part-time animals accumulates as the diner is operated together with the part-time workers.
Friendship increases only when the part-time worker is nearby, not when he or she is out of sight. The rate of increase is also higher when the diner is open.
Then, when the " friendship" reaches a certain level, the part-time job's LV will increase and BP will be obtained.
By assigning this BP on the skill board, you can add special abilities to that part-time job.

The Halloween event has ended and we are now in November.

Also, Apple harvest basket will store apples, honey, cocoas, and mushrooms.
I would like to thank the user who gave us this idea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/b2c2504ff7b97429d3d3009894036973398a777f.jpg[/img]

This new level unlocks the following features
[list]
[*][b]Pizza oven[/b]
Peddling robots will now sell "Pizza oven".
I love pizza! Yay!!!!!
By purchasing and installing a pizza oven, a new pizza recipe will be added to the oven recipe.
Bake all sorts of pizzas to please all your customers!
[*][b]Advanced Skill 2[/b]
Skill tree of "Advanced Skill 2" will appear in the clover tree.
In this skill tree, you will be able to learn skills that increase the production rate of "Popcorn Machine", "Coffee Maker", or etc..
[*][b]Expansion of the maximum number of chairs installed[/b]
When you reach a certain number of level, the number of chairs you can place in the diner will be capped.
Currently, this limit can be increased by using "Advanced Skill tree" in the Clover Tree.

In addition to this, "BEZZEPE.BR", the construction robots will now be working on expanding the maximum number of chairs in the diner.
If you have reached Lv23 and would like to have more chairs in the diner, please visit her.
[/list]

[/list]

[h3]The Baby Espresso Incident[/h3]

There was a bug that caused baby animals to try to drink espresso or cappuccino for the compelling reason that "it's not called coffee". However, this has been fixed. Hey babies, espresso and cappuccino are both coffee!


[h3]Cats meowing in the middle of the night, a strange phenomenon[/h3]

There have been several reports of strange phenomena such as the occasional large number of cats meowing in the middle of the night.
However, the cause of this has finally been discovered.
This happens when a table with gold coins left on it is collected in installation mode.
This was a bug that caused the cat to keep purring as it tried to find the gold coins that had been put away with the table.
I have fixed this bug, so from now on, the cat can sleep peacefully without having to keep looking for the missing gold coins throughout the night.
Good night, kitty!

"Candy apple" has been added to the alchemy recipe.


[h3]SE at the start of cooking has been added.[/h3]


[h3]Fixed equipment change shortcuts.[/h3]

When there is equipment in the active window, it can be changed with the number keys from 1 to 0 (excluding the numeric keypad). (As before, you can also change it with the mouse wheel)

Along with this, when changing the equipment in the active window with the mouse wheel, the bug that the equipment in the distant frame cannot be selected has been fixed.


[h3]Animals fight[/h3]

Even if it is the last diner in the world, it is not always peaceful.
When various animals came to visit, some animals would cause fights.
If such a fight occurs, please gently soothe them and make them reconcile.
It would be great if your diner could protect the friendship between the animals.
This is the content from Lv8.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/88c5c58c0d0b484a136ad78244893e58bb1b0d92.png[/img]


[h3]part time job[/h3]

In your diner, which has become a very popular restaurant, animals that want to work part-time have come to appear.
If there were such animals, it might be good to fulfill their wishes.
However, what they can do is limited.
When the customer ordered the drink set on the pitcher table, they poured the drink and handed it to the customer.
That's all they can do.
Even so, if you want to stand in the kitchen with cute animals, please hire them.
This event occurs at Lv7 or higher.


[h3]Very very hungry animals[/h3]

It seems that some animals, very rarely, visit the diner from a tremendous distance.
They are about to die, probably because they have traveled a tremendous distance, or because they are so hungry.
If such an animal comes to the store, please provide a lot of meals.
Hungry animals will be happy.
This event is Lv3 or higher and occurs very rarely.


[h3]Diner code[/h3]

If your friends and family are playing World End Diner, have you ever wanted to invite them to your diner?
This is a simple function to realize it in a pseudo manner.
You can do that by selecting the diner code item from the OPTION menu.
For example, if you tell us the diner code of your friends and family and copy and paste it, their appearance will appear on your island.
You can add up to 5 diner codes.


[h3]The tragedy of a kitchen site[/h3]

There was an item "Create a kitchen site" in one of the facility expansion menus for construction robots, but we decided to hide this item in Lv7 and below.

This is because there were many cases in which the name "kitchen site" caused a slight misunderstanding when it was written in Japanese. (In Japanese, it was "separated workshop")

Actually, this item extends only a small kitchen area at a distance.
However, from the naming in Japanese notation, it made me feel like a wonderful atelier for making pictures and crafts. Players who expected it must have been disappointed to see the actual expansion.
Therefore, in order not to repeat such a tragedy, the item itself is hidden in the low level band, and even if it is Lv8 or higher, the annotation is displayed in the case of Japanese.
I'm sorry if anyone misunderstood and was discouraged.

And, in order not to waste the sacrifice of the players who suffered this tragedy, I would like to add a function that can really make pictures and crafts in future development.


[h3]Other updates and bug fixes[/h3]

In rare cases, golden chests will appear in the treasure chests on the island. The chest can get more gold coins than usual.

A new crypto book has been added.
Guinea pigs have been added as new animals.
A new robot has been added.
Some new quests have been added.
Furniture can no longer be installed in one square behind the counter.

Other minor bug fixes.


This is the end of this update report.


As usual, thank you to everyone who reported bugs and distributed videos.
Also, thank you to everyone who wrote the STEAM review during this period!
Seeing them gave me a lot of motivation and courage. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

Writing a STEAM review makes me very happy and encouraged above all.

Also, if the number of reviews exceeds around 50, it will probably be possible to add functions such as STEAM trading cards, badges and wallpapers, so thank you for your cooperation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40615515/a7dd32876b090048c1a29251524b57da70f92e78.png[/img]


We will continue to update it in order to add various contents.
Please look forward to it!

[h3]The bucket bug war has finally come to an end.[/h3]

Initially, there was a terrifying bug that caused the bucket to be lost forever.
One of the users who distributed the video on Youtube, akazo, who first discovered this, stated in his video as follows.
"The bucket has disappeared ... No, but in a long life, the bucket may disappear suddenly, so I don't care."
I was deeply impressed by the philosophical and perceptive words and fixed the bug.

However, fixing that bug resulted in another new bug.
It was a bucket proliferation bug that evolved from the bucket disappearance bug and became a new figure.

This new bucket bug was a horrifying bug that allowed you to increase the number of buckets infinitely.
If the number of buckets keeps increasing, your wonderful diner will be crushed by the buckets!

However, I finally succeeded in getting rid of this bug today.
Currently, the shortage is automatically added to those who have lost their buckets.
On the contrary, for those who had too many buckets due to proliferation, it will be automatically corrected so that it will be the original number.

Thus, the bucket bug war was successfully over.
We would like to inform you that peaceful days with a safe bucket have arrived for your diner.
